data.one_liner: Widgets to display Twemoji icons and render text with emoji support in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Twemoji widget for single emoji display and TwemojiText/TwemojiTextSpan for rendering emojis inside regular text. Includes optional asset filtering to reduce bundle size.
use_when: You need emoji graphics that match Twitter's Twemoji style
You want easy inline emoji rendering without custom parsing
You want to shrink bundle size by including only specific emojis
avoid_when: You require platform‑native emoji fonts instead of image assets
You need animated or custom emoji sets beyond Twemoji
strengths: Supports SVG assets for crisp scaling
weaknesses: Relies on bundled SVG assets, increasing app size if many emojis are included
Limited to Twemoji set; no custom emoji support

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a large set of vector icons, including some emoji-like symbols, without extra asset management
